opening.argument: The presentation is a technical developer community discussion centered on dynamic minimum block times and ACP-226. It explains a proposed mechanism, including how validator configuration specifies a preferred minimum block delay in milliseconds, and presents implementation details concerning block production and validator preferences. These are operational and educational subjects, not promises of wealth or instructions to obtain financial returns. The repository invitation is framed as a place to find further project information, rather than as a wealth offer or a condition for participation. The evidence therefore supports treating the material as an educational technology discussion and operational demonstration.

citations.quote: Avalanche Developer Community Call: Dynamic Minimum Block Times (ACP-226)

configuration for validator just allows you to specify the preferred minimum block delay in milliseconds
